spec.name: Orange Kitchen Stockpot
spec.description: A warm ceramic stove cabinet supporting a large open copper stockpot, with stepped corners, sturdy loop handles, a dark interior and a wooden ladle resting across the rim. Front faces -Z; base rests at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Stockpot. Full kitchen cabinet/stove supporting a large open copper stockpot with handles, dark inner bowl and ladle resting at edge. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
